construction: Sixteen deck-only normal openings: eight material lineups x two seats. Existing opponent, Quickdraw, Bulb, Halq and Borrelsword objective unchanged. Seat0 includes a normal first turn and last-zone placement. No synthetic field injection or actor code-ID aliasing; role substitution exists only inside reference policy.
admission: Each lineup/seat has successful attack-position Bulb continuation and failed defense-position contrast, repeated twice, identical position roots and independent core audit. No fitting until all references pass. Keep all descendants in the existing combo development family.
batch: 8 own-seat histories x64 per update: four existing normal references cycling six profiles, one previously admitted exact correction, one successful current-parent synthetic combo KL anchor, and two new fit material references (both seats) cycling four lineups. Identical learner shapes, steps and old losses in both arms; only new-material CE coefficient differs.
retention: Freeze the same77fe candidate for all parent outputs. Recompute each model's own RNN from full history. Preserve previous exact-root-only correction and independent full-scene synthetic combo KL. New material histories receive CE only, never anchor known errors. Original synthetic combo remains declared rehearsal.
split: Four fit lineups and four reserved lineups fixed before collecting model scores. Reserved combination and material descendants never enter CE/KL fitting, intermediate probes, sampling or checkpoint selection. Gila is absent from this study's supervised references but not claimed unseen in pretraining. All are one existing mechanism family, not new-family generalization.
evaluation: Baseline and fixed endpoints: all48 new takeover configurations (16 openings x opening/Halq/Bulb depth), plus prior78 regressions. Each twice with independent audit. Intermediate checks only base old openings and new fit openings. No adaptation after observing reserved outcomes.
success_gate: Add_materials passes all24 fit takeover configurations; at least6 additional reserved takeover successes versus old_curriculum, and all78 original regressions retained. If baseline is saturated, report no identifiable learning benefit. All126 needed for complete exercise gate; no full-game strength claim.
stop: 1024 updates per arm or nonfinite metrics/history mismatch/audit rejection/asset drift/time limit. No automatic continuation, production promotion, PPO, native rebuild or reward change. Record data generation and evaluation costs.
